Stop.DefaultText: Environment action. Pay attention to the scene.

Settings.Intro: Configure the text and appearance of your requests. Click an image to submit a request, or drag it to the hotbar.
Settings.ImageTitle: Submit a request or drag it to the hotbar
Settings.FontSizeInvalid: Enter a valid CSS font size, for example 1.2em, 18px, or clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem).

MasterSettings.MenuName: dmicher Spotlight Tools — Game Master Settings
MasterSettings.MenuHint: Configure the world-wide Request Feed, Request Anti-Spam Limits, Images, Sounds, and Welcome Message blocks.

Overview.Title: Overview
Overview.Intro: The request system creates one managed queue for remarks and scene actions. Choose a page on the left to find the purpose of a window, setting, or button.

Regular.Label: Regular request
Regular.Description: A player's request to speak in the normal order.

Urgent.Label: Urgent request
Urgent.Description: Marks a remark as urgent and counts it separately in the queue summary.

Environment.Label: Environment
Environment.Description: A scene-action request available to a Game Master or Assistant; resolving it with Take the floor pauses the world.

Queue.Label: Active queue
Queue.Description: Stores every unresolved request in submission order and remains available independently of open windows.

Chat.Label: Connection to chat
Chat.Description: Chat cards can be disabled while the active queue, Request Feed, and Active Requests window continue to work.

Identity.Label: Request author
Identity.Description: Stores the player, selected actor or token, portrait, request type, and submission time.

Authority.Label: Authoritative validation
Authority.Description: An active Game Master or Assistant checks permissions and limits again before adding an entry.

Resolution.Label: Resolution
Resolution.Description: Granting or cancelling removes the entry from the queue and deletes its linked chat card.

Contents.Label: Contents
Contents.Description: The buttons on the left switch pages inside Help and never open a browser.

Theme.Label: Module window theme
Theme.Description: The first entry in the module section of Game Settings switches module windows between light and dark appearance for the current user.

OpenSettings.Label: Open Request Settings
OpenSettings.Description: The bottom button opens the separate personal Request Settings window.

OpenMasterSettings.Label: Game Master Settings
OpenMasterSettings.Description: The button in the module section of Game Settings opens a separate window for shared world controls; it is available to a Game Master or Assistant.

OpenManagement.Label: Open Active Requests
OpenManagement.Description: The bottom button opens Active Requests for Game Master queue review and control.

ModuleMenu.Label: Module settings
ModuleMenu.Description: The module section of Game Settings contains Open Request Settings, then Game Master Settings for a moderator, Open Help, and Thank the Author.

SceneControls.Label: Spotlight Tools
SceneControls.Description: The upper-left controls show Help and Active Requests buttons to a Game Master among the module tools.

Players.Title: For players
Players.Intro: This page describes personal settings, ways to submit a request, chat-card buttons, and volume control.

SettingsWindow.Label: Request Settings window
SettingsWindow.Description: Contains the request types available to the user and their personal text and styling; shared world controls have moved to the separate Game Master Settings window.

RequestBlock.Label: Request-type section
RequestBlock.Description: A separate block configures regular, urgent, or moderator-only environment requests.

Image.Label: Request image
Image.Description: Clicking submits a request; dragging creates a hotbar macro.

Text.Label: Text field
Text.Description: Sets the personal plain-text card content; HTML and CSS-like input is displayed literally, and an empty value uses the type default.

Color.Label: Color
Color.Description: The palette chooses a color, while the adjacent editable field shows and accepts the same value in #rrggbb format.

FontSize.Label: Font size
FontSize.Description: Accepts an arbitrary valid CSS font-size value such as 1.2em, 18px, or clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem).

Underline.Label: u button
Underline.Description: Toggles underlining; its pressed state is shown directly on the button.

Italic.Label: i button
Italic.Description: Toggles italic type and displays the sample character in italics.

Bold.Label: b button
Bold.Description: Toggles bold type and displays the sample character in bold.

Alignment.Label: Alignment list
Alignment.Description: Selects center alignment by default, or left and right alignment.

Save.Label: Save button
Save.Description: Saves only the current user's personal fields; shared world controls are saved separately in Game Master Settings.

TimeoutOverlay.Label: Image countdown
TimeoutOverlay.Description: When this request type is timed out for the current user, a live countdown is shown over its image.

Click.Label: Click an image
Click.Description: Immediately attempts to add the selected request type to the active queue.

Drag.Label: Drag
Drag.Description: Creates an executable request macro in the selected hotbar slot.

ExistingMacro.Label: Existing macro
ExistingMacro.Description: Keeps its old icon but uses the module's current behavior, resources, and limits when executed.

RestrictionFeedback.Label: Limit warning
RestrictionFeedback.Description: A forbidden type, exceeded count, or active environment prevents creation and shows the reason.

ModeratorRequired.Label: Active moderator
ModeratorRequired.Description: At least one active Game Master or Assistant must be present to accept a request.

MacroMetadata.Label: Macro comments
MacroMetadata.Description: When a macro is created, the module prefixes its command with comments containing the owning player's name and ID and the exact creation time.

MacroCleanup.Label: Removing from the hotbar
MacroCleanup.Description: After removal, all 50 slots of the current user's hotbar are checked. If that exact module macro is no longer assigned, it is deleted from the Macros collection; other users' and ordinary macros are untouched.

Card.Label: Card
Card.Description: Shows the type, personal text, and current image when the Game Master enables request chat output.

Cancel.Label: Cancel button
Cancel.Description: Available to the author and moderators; removes the request and its linked card.

Grant.Label: Give the floor button
Grant.Description: Available to moderators for regular and urgent requests; resolves the entry and shows a two-line notification with the portrait, request type, player name, and known character name.

TakeFloor.Label: Take the floor button
TakeFloor.Description: Resolves an environment request for the moderator and pauses the game world.

Technical.Label: Result message
Technical.Description: When chat output is enabled, reports the type, waiting time, and resolution to the participants.

Slider.Label: Playlists → User Volume Controls → Requests
Slider.Description: The speaker control and slider set request sound volume only for the current user.

Formula.Label: Final volume
Formula.Description: The Game Master's base volume for the type is multiplied by the user's personal volume.

Mute.Label: 0% value
Mute.Description: Personal zero mutes only that user; a base zero set by the Game Master mutes the sound for everyone.

FoundryMute.Label: Foundry global mute
FoundryMute.Description: Foundry's hotbar mute button takes priority: request sounds are not started while global mute is enabled.

MasterSettings.Title: Game Master Settings
MasterSettings.Intro: This separate window contains shared request controls for the world and is available only to a Game Master or Assistant.

Window.Label: Game Master Settings window
Window.Description: Shared world controls have moved out of personal Request Settings and are saved independently.

GameSettingsButton.Label: Game Master Settings button
GameSettingsButton.Description: Located in the module section of Game Settings between Open Request Settings and Open Help.

ModeratorOnly.Label: Access
ModeratorOnly.Description: A Game Master or Assistant sees the button and window; regular players configure only their own requests.

Feed.Label: Request Feed
Feed.Description: The first block enables Request Feed for the world and controls submission time; both switches are enabled on first activation.

Limits.Label: Request Anti-Spam Limits
Limits.Description: The second block controls chat output, count limits, prohibitions, timeouts, and blocking during an active Environment request; initial values are detailed on the anti-spam page.

Images.Label: Images
Images.Description: The third block configures Regular, Urgent, and Environment images; module defaults are used initially.

Sounds.Label: Sounds
Sounds.Description: The fourth block controls request, timer, and break sounds, URLs, volume, and previews. Request sounds start enabled and no custom sounds are configured.

Welcome.Label: Welcome Message
Welcome.Description: The final block controls the private startup message; Welcome is enabled by default.

Save.Label: Save button
Save.Description: Saves shared world controls; changing whether Request Feed is enabled prompts the user to reload the client.

Management.Title: Active Requests
Management.Intro: The Game Master window displays the full queue, can temporarily hide rows, and provides resolution controls.

WindowCounter.Label: Number in the window title
WindowCounter.Description: Shows the total number of active requests.

Totals.Label: Total requests line
Totals.Description: Shows the complete entry count and the number of urgent requests.

VisibleCounter.Label: Visible counter
VisibleCounter.Description: Shows how many rows remain after type filters and duplicate hiding.

Refresh.Label: Automatic refresh
Refresh.Description: The queue and relative times update after changes and periodically while the window is open.

Type.Label: Type group
Type.Description: Regular, urgent, and environment checkboxes immediately show or hide matching rows.

DuplicatesNone.Label: Do not hide
DuplicatesNone.Description: Shows every active request in queue order.

DuplicatesType.Label: By type
DuplicatesType.Description: Keeps the first request from each player for each type; different types remain visible.

DuplicatesPlayer.Label: By player
DuplicatesPlayer.Description: Keeps only the first request from each player regardless of type.

Images.Label: # cell
Images.Description: Shows the selected token, actor, or player portrait beside the request-type image.

Submitted.Label: Submitted column
Submitted.Description: Shows the time elapsed since submission.

Author.Label: Author column
Author.Description: Shows the player name followed by the selected character name when present.

OpenMessage.Label: Go to request message button (eye)
OpenMessage.Description: Jumps to the linked chat card and is absent for requests without a card.

Grant.Label: Give the floor or Take the floor button
Grant.Description: Grants the floor, removes the request, and shows a two-line notification with the portrait, request type, player name, and known character name.

Cancel.Label: Cancel request button
Cancel.Description: Cancels only the selected request and deletes its linked chat card.

ResetTimeouts.Label: Reset Timers button
ResetTimeouts.Description: Appears to the left of Environment Request when either type has a configured timeout; after confirmation it clears every current timeout.

EnvironmentRequest.Label: Environment Request button
EnvironmentRequest.Description: Submits an environment request from the current moderator through the shared queue; image, sound, chat, and active-environment limit settings apply.

Clear.Label: Clear button
Clear.Description: After confirmation, cancels every active request and deletes linked messages.

Empty.Label: Empty queue
Empty.Description: Shows an empty-state message instead of the table.

EnvironmentGrant.Label: Resolve environment
EnvironmentGrant.Description: Take the floor removes the environment request and pauses the world.

Customization.Title: Images, sounds, and welcome
Customization.Intro: The Images, Sounds, and Welcome Message blocks are in the separate Game Master Settings window after Request Feed and Request Anti-Spam Limits and are configured by a moderator for the whole world.

TypeSections.Label: Type sections
TypeSections.Description: Regular, urgent, and environment images are configured independently.

CustomToggle.Label: Custom image toggle
CustomToggle.Description: Enables the required external URL field for the selected type; it starts off and uses the module image.

Url.Label: URL field
Url.Description: When enabled, it must contain a direct image URL accessible to the Foundry client through CORS.

Validation.Label: Save validation
Validation.Description: The module downloads and decodes the image; an unavailable or invalid resource is not saved.

Preview.Label: Preview on the right
Preview.Description: Shows the current image used by cards, Request Feed, and newly created macros.

ExistingMacros.Label: Existing macros
ExistingMacros.Description: Their icon is not replaced automatically, but execution displays the current request image.

GlobalToggle.Label: Enable request sounds
GlobalToggle.Description: Enables or disables all request sound playback in the world; it is enabled by default.

CustomToggle.Label: Custom sound toggle
CustomToggle.Description: Enables an external URL for one type; it starts off and uses the standard sound.

Url.Label: URL field
Url.Description: When enabled, it must contain a direct CORS-accessible URL to playable audio.

BaseVolume.Label: Base volume slider
BaseVolume.Description: Sets 0–100% for the selected type before personal user volume is applied.

Preview.Label: Play/stop button
Preview.Description: Previews the sound selected in the form using the current base and personal volumes.

FinalVolume.Label: Combined volume
FinalVolume.Description: Playback uses the product of the type's base level and the user's Requests slider.

TimerCustom.Label: Custom timer sound
TimerCustom.Description: Enables a required URL, base volume, and preview for the custom ordinary-timer signal; it is off by default.

BreakCustom.Label: Custom break signal
BreakCustom.Description: Independently enables a URL, base volume, and preview for the quick-break signal; it is off by default.

TimerVolume.Label: Personal timer volume
TimerVolume.Description: The Timers slider in Playlists applies to normal, poll, and break timers.

FoundryMute.Label: Foundry global mute
FoundryMute.Description: Foundry's global mute also blocks every module sound preview button.

Toggle.Label: Show welcome message
Toggle.Description: Enables a private startup message for each joining user; it is enabled by default. The moderator welcome provides a direct link to Game Master Settings.

PlayerMessage.Label: Player text
PlayerMessage.Description: Reports that the module is active, shows its exact manifest title and installed version, and opens Request Settings from the game menu link.

ModeratorMessage.Label: Moderator addition
ModeratorMessage.Description: Game Masters and Assistants also receive links that open Help and Game Master Settings, where this welcome can be disabled.

InternalButtons.Label: Message buttons
InternalButtons.Description: The game menu, Help, and Game Master Settings links open windows inside Foundry; only the support link is intended for an external page.

Free.Label: Free module
Free.Description: Below a horizontal divider, smaller text tells every user that all module functionality is free.

Support.Label: Support link
Support.Description: The “at this link” button opens the existing author thanks page.

Limits.Title: Request Anti-Spam Limits
Limits.Intro: Request Anti-Spam Limits is the second block in Game Master Settings, immediately after Request Feed. Its rules apply to every new submission attempt and are checked again by a moderator before queue storage.

ChatToggle.Label: Post requests to chat
ChatToggle.Description: Creates a card for each accepted request and a technical message after resolution; it is enabled by default.

QueueWithoutChat.Label: Toggle off
QueueWithoutChat.Description: Requests remain in the active queue, Request Feed, and Active Requests window, but no chat card is created.

RegularSection.Label: Regular request section
RegularSection.Description: Configures Regular request limits. By default there is no count limit and no timeout.

UrgentSection.Label: Urgent request section
UrgentSection.Description: Configures Urgent request limits. By default each player may have one active request and a 10-minute timeout starts when the floor is granted.

Unlimited.Label: Unlimited
Unlimited.Description: Allows any number of active requests of the selected type.

CountMode.Label: Limit per player
CountMode.Description: Limits active requests of this type separately for each author.

CountField.Label: Count field
CountField.Description: Enabled in count mode and accepts an integer from 1 to 10.

Forbidden.Label: Forbidden
Forbidden.Description: Blocks new requests of the type; its controls are disabled and old macros show a warning.

TimeoutSelect.Label: Timeout
TimeoutSelect.Description: A separate selector in each type section chooses which event starts that request type's restriction.

TimeoutNone.Label: Unlimited
TimeoutNone.Description: No timeout is applied and the Time field is disabled.

TimeoutSubmission.Label: From submission
TimeoutSubmission.Description: The countdown starts when this player's request of this type is accepted into the queue; cancelling it later does not remove the timeout.

TimeoutGrant.Label: From granted floor
TimeoutGrant.Description: The countdown starts only after Grant is used for this request type. Cancellation by the player or a moderator does not count as granting the floor.

TimeoutTime.Label: Time
TimeoutTime.Description: A duration in HH:MM:SS timer format; active only for the two timeout modes. The initial Urgent duration is 00:10:00.

Toggle.Label: Block new requests while an environment request is active
Toggle.Description: Enables a special restriction while Environment is active; it is enabled by default.

AllTypes.Label: Every type
AllTypes.Description: Blocks regular, urgent, and repeated environment requests regardless of the author's role.

Priority.Label: Validation priority
Priority.Description: An active environment rejects a new submission before forbidden-type and count checks.

ExistingQueue.Label: Existing entries
ExistingQueue.Description: The toggle does not remove queued entries; it affects only later submission attempts.

LocalCheck.Label: Sender check
LocalCheck.Description: The client immediately shows a warning and starts neither chat nor sound for a known violation.

AuthoritativeCheck.Label: Moderator check
AuthoritativeCheck.Description: The primary active Game Master or Assistant repeats the check against the current queue to prevent bypass.

Warnings.Label: Warning text
Warnings.Description: Explains the specific reason: forbidden type, reached count, or active environment.

TimeoutDisplay.Label: Live countdown
TimeoutDisplay.Description: Remaining time is overlaid on this request image in Request Settings and on the submission buttons at the bottom of Request Feed.

TimeoutWarning.Label: Submission attempt
TimeoutWarning.Description: Clicking or running an existing macro before expiry does not create a request; the warning includes the remaining time.

TimeoutDrag.Label: Macro drag
TimeoutDrag.Description: An active timeout does not prevent dragging a request to the hotbar; the hotbar macro itself has no countdown overlay.

TimeoutReset.Label: Manual reset
TimeoutReset.Description: A moderator can clear every current timeout from Request Feed or Active Requests; active requests remain in the queue.

TimeoutExpiry.Label: Expiry
TimeoutExpiry.Description: When the countdown reaches zero, the restriction automatically stops blocking new submissions.

Feed.Title: Request Feed
Feed.Intro: Request Feed is the Foundry sidebar tab that gives every user a compact queue view, quick request controls, and actions permitted to their role.

Settings.Title: Request Feed block in Game Master Settings

Enable.Label: Enable toggle
Enable.Description: Adds or removes the Request Feed sidebar tab for the world; it is enabled by default.

ReloadPrompt.Label: Reload prompt
ReloadPrompt.Description: Appears after the changed toggle is saved because Foundry must rebuild the sidebar.

ReloadNow.Label: Reload button
ReloadNow.Description: Reloads the client immediately to apply the new tab set.

ReloadLater.Label: Later button
ReloadLater.Description: Keeps the saved setting but delays rebuilding until the next reload.

ShowTime.Label: Show time toggle
ShowTime.Description: Adds relative submission time to every Request Feed row; it is enabled by default.

Tab.Label: Request Feed tab button
Tab.Description: Appears after Combat and before Scenes and opens Request Feed.

Images.Label: Two images
Images.Description: Show the author or character portrait and the request-type image.

Names.Label: Name and character
Names.Description: The player name is primary; the selected character name appears below when available.

Time.Label: Relative time
Time.Description: Appears only when enabled and updates periodically.

Empty.Label: Empty Request Feed
Empty.Description: Reports that no requests are active while keeping footer actions available.

PlayerCancel.Label: Cancel request button (trash)
PlayerCancel.Description: Allows an author to cancel only their own request.

ModeratorGrant.Label: Give the floor or Take the floor button
ModeratorGrant.Description: Allows a moderator to resolve a request; environment resolution also pauses the world.

ModeratorCancel.Label: Cancel request button (trash)
ModeratorCancel.Description: Allows a moderator to cancel any request without granting the floor.

MacroClick.Label: Request images
MacroClick.Description: Clicking attempts to submit a type available to the current user.

MacroDrag.Label: Drag a request image
MacroDrag.Description: Creates a hotbar macro; current limits are still enforced when it is used.

Settings.Label: Request Settings button
Settings.Description: Opens the personal Request Settings window for any user.

ResetTimeouts.Label: Reset Timers button
ResetTimeouts.Description: Visible only to a moderator and only when either type has a configured timeout; after confirmation it clears all player timeouts.

Management.Label: Active Requests button
Management.Description: Visible to a moderator and opens Active Requests.

TimeoutOverlay.Label: Timeout countdown
TimeoutOverlay.Description: The regular or urgent submission button in Request Feed shows the current user's personal remaining timeout.

PollsOverview.Title: Overview
PollsOverview.Intro: Polls let a moderator quickly collect one or several answers from selected participants.

Manager.Label: Polls window
Manager.Description: Opens the template list, poll creation, launch controls, and latest results.

ModeratorOnly.Label: Permissions
ModeratorOnly.Description: GMs and assistants manage polls; players only receive voting cards assigned to them.

WorldState.Label: World state
WorldState.Description: Templates, the active poll, responses, and the latest result are stored in the world.

OneActive.Label: One active poll
OneActive.Description: Only one poll can run at a time. Finish the current poll before starting another.

Buttons.Label: Buttons
Buttons.Description: One answer from up to four options. Clicking an option submits it immediately.

Radio.Label: Single choice
Radio.Description: A table of radio buttons with one answer from up to twelve options.

Checkbox.Label: Multiple choice
Checkbox.Description: A table of checkboxes with several answers from up to twelve options.

Text.Label: Text
Text.Description: A free-form answer of up to 500 characters; no options are used.

Template.Label: Template
Template.Description: A reusable preset stores the question, type, options, participants, and timer settings.

Launch.Label: Launch
Launch.Description: The moderator can adjust participants, options, and timer use before sending.

PrivateRequest.Label: Player card
PrivateRequest.Description: Every selected participant receives a private card visible to them and moderators.

Answer.Label: Response
Answer.Description: The first accepted response is final for that participant and run.

Finish.Label: Finish
Finish.Description: The moderator finishes manually; pending participants become no-answer and the result is saved.

PollsTemplates.Title: Templates
PollsTemplates.Intro: The main window stores reusable templates and links to launch controls and latest results.

Macro.Label: Macro image
Macro.Description: Drag the row image to the hotbar to create a launch macro for this template.

Name.Label: Name
Name.Description: The name button opens the selected template for editing.

Type.Label: Type
Type.Description: Shows buttons, single choice, multiple choice, or text.

LastResult.Label: Latest result
LastResult.Description: Shows answered participants against the total assigned in the latest run.

Edit.Label: Edit
Edit.Description: Loads all saved template values into the form.

Start.Label: Start
Start.Description: Opens the launch preparation window for this template.

Results.Label: Results
Results.Description: Opens the latest saved result; disabled until a result exists.

Delete.Label: Delete
Delete.Description: Deletes the template. A template used by the active poll cannot be deleted.

NewTemplate.Label: New poll
NewTemplate.Description: Clears the form and starts a new template.

PollName.Label: Name
PollName.Description: An internal template name up to 120 characters.

Question.Label: Question
Question.Description: Text shown to participants, up to 240 characters.

TypeSelect.Label: Type
TypeSelect.Description: Selects the voting interface and option limit.

Options.Label: Options
Options.Description: Each option is limited to 80 characters; text polls do not use options.

OptionToggle.Label: Option checkbox
OptionToggle.Description: Includes that option in the poll. Disabled rows are not sent.

Participants.Label: Participants
Participants.Description: Checkboxes select recipients; selected and active users sort first.

TimerToggle.Label: Start poll timer
TimerToggle.Description: Creates a normal public timer along with the poll.

TimerTime.Label: Timer time
TimerTime.Description: Accepts seconds, MM:SS, or HH:MM:SS and must be positive.

TimerSound.Label: Timer sound
TimerSound.Description: Selects silence or one of the three standard signals.

Cancel.Label: Cancel
Cancel.Description: Cancels editing and restores the initial form state.

Save.Label: Save
Save.Description: Creates a template or saves changes to the current one.

StartTemporary.Label: Start without saving
StartTemporary.Description: Runs the current form as a temporary poll without adding a template.

RestoreDefaults.Label: Restore defaults
RestoreDefaults.Description: Adds new copies of built-in templates without deleting custom ones.

ClearActive.Label: Finish current
ClearActive.Description: Closes the active poll, saves its result, and frees the active slot.

Drag.Label: Drag
Drag.Description: Creates or updates a hotbar macro that opens launch preparation.

Existing.Label: Existing macro
Existing.Description: Always resolves the current template by its identifier.

MissingTemplate.Label: Deleted template
MissingTemplate.Description: If the template was deleted, the macro reports that it is unavailable.

Metadata.Label: Owner and creation time
Metadata.Description: The macro command begins with comments containing the owning player's name and ID and the exact creation time.

Cleanup.Label: Automatic cleanup
Cleanup.Description: Removing the last current-user hotbar assignment deletes that exact module macro from the Macros collection without touching ordinary or other users' macros.

PollsLaunch.Title: Launch preparation
PollsLaunch.Intro: Adjust one poll run without changing the stored template.

Type.Label: Type
Type.Description: Shows the response type stored in the template.

SelectedCount.Label: Participant count
SelectedCount.Description: Updates immediately as recipient checkboxes change.

Question.Label: Question
Question.Description: Shows the text that participants will receive.

Enable.Label: Start timer
Enable.Description: Enables or disables the timer for this run only.

Time.Label: Time
Time.Description: Shows the duration saved in the template.

Sound.Label: Sound
Sound.Description: Shows the saved standard signal or silence.

OrdinaryTimer.Label: Separate timer
OrdinaryTimer.Description: The poll timer is a normal public timer and does not finish the poll automatically.

Selection.Label: Checkboxes
Selection.Description: Choose who receives a private voting card.

Inactive.Label: Inactive users
Inactive.Description: They may be selected in advance but can answer only after connecting.

Required.Label: Required selection
Required.Description: At least one participant is required.

Enable.Label: Option checkbox
Enable.Description: Excludes an option from this run only.

Rename.Label: Option text
Rename.Description: Can be changed for this run without editing the template.

Limits.Label: Limits
Limits.Description: Up to four buttons or twelve table rows are available.

Text.Label: Text poll
Text.Description: Shows no options; participants enter a free-form answer.

FinishCurrent.Label: Finish current
FinishCurrent.Description: Finishes an existing active poll before the new launch.

Start.Label: Start
Start.Description: Creates the active poll, private cards, and optional timer.

Validation.Label: Validation
Validation.Description: Launch is blocked without participants, a question, or required enabled options.

PollsVoting.Title: Voting
PollsVoting.Intro: A player answers from a private chat card; the primary moderator accepts the response authoritatively.

PrivateCard.Label: Private card
PrivateCard.Description: The message is whispered to the assigned player and moderators.

Moderators.Label: Moderator view
Moderators.Description: GMs and assistants can see participant cards and response status.

TargetOnly.Label: Protected controls
TargetOnly.Description: Interactive controls are hidden from users who were not assigned the card.

ButtonChoice.Label: Buttons
ButtonChoice.Description: Clicking one button submits that option immediately.

RadioChoice.Label: Single choice
RadioChoice.Description: Select one radio button and submit.

CheckboxChoice.Label: Multiple choice
CheckboxChoice.Description: Select one or more checkboxes and submit.

TextAnswer.Label: Text
TextAnswer.Description: Enter a free-form response up to 500 characters.

Submit.Label: Submit
Submit.Description: Sends the completed form to the moderator for authoritative storage.

Cancel.Label: Decline
Cancel.Description: Form-based poll types allow the participant to decline answering.

Empty.Label: Empty response
Empty.Description: A form cannot be submitted without a selection or non-empty text.

PrimaryModerator.Label: Primary moderator
PrimaryModerator.Description: Validates the participant and active run, then updates world state.

FirstAnswer.Label: First response
FirstAnswer.Description: Once accepted, the response status cannot be submitted again.

RequestRemoved.Label: Request removed
RequestRemoved.Description: The interactive request card is deleted after acceptance.

ResultMessage.Label: Confirmation
ResultMessage.Description: A private result message replaces it with the recorded answer.

PollsResults.Title: Results
PollsResults.Intro: The results window combines an aggregate summary with every participant's status.

Started.Label: Started
Started.Description: Shows when the poll was sent.

StartedBy.Label: Started by
StartedBy.Description: Shows the moderator who launched it.

Options.Label: Option
Options.Description: Each row represents one enabled answer option.

Counts.Label: Count
Counts.Description: Shows votes and sorts rows from most to least.

Voters.Label: Voters
Voters.Description: Lists participants who selected the option.

TextNoSummary.Label: Text responses
TextNoSummary.Description: Free text has no aggregate table; answers appear in the detailed list.

Post.Label: Post to chat
Post.Description: Publishes the result summary to game chat.

Finish.Label: Finish
Finish.Description: Closes the active poll and marks pending users as no-answer.

Close.Label: Close
Close.Description: Closes the window without changing the saved result.

TemporaryClose.Label: Temporary poll
TemporaryClose.Description: Closing an active temporary result asks before discarding it.

Pending.Label: Pending users
Pending.Description: Participants without a response become no-answer.

LastResult.Label: Latest result
LastResult.Description: A saved template keeps the result accessible from its table row.

TimerSeparate.Label: Timer
TimerSeparate.Description: The associated timer is independent and is not deleted when the poll finishes.

TimersOverview.Title: Overview
TimersOverview.Intro: Timers share a deadline with the world, support public and private visibility, and use configurable signals.

Manager.Label: Timers window
Manager.Description: Contains the new timer form and every timer visible to the moderator.

ModeratorOnly.Label: Permissions
ModeratorOnly.Description: GMs and assistants can create, cancel, and delete timers.

WorldState.Label: World state
WorldState.Description: Active and expired timers are stored in the world and synchronized.

Public.Label: Public
Public.Description: The timer window and chat message are visible to everyone.

Private.Label: Private
Private.Description: Only moderators see the timer and its chat message.

AutoOpen.Label: Automatic opening
AutoOpen.Description: Public timers open on launch and are rediscovered by connecting clients.

Chat.Label: Chat message
Chat.Description: Records the deadline and provides a button to reopen the window.

Duration.Label: Duration
Duration.Description: Accepts SS, MM:SS, or HH:MM:SS and counts down that interval.

Deadline.Label: Deadline
Deadline.Description: Accepts a time of day and counts down to its nearest occurrence.

NextDay.Label: Next day
NextDay.Description: A time already passed today is moved to the next day.

Accuracy.Label: Updates
Accuracy.Description: Windows and table cells refresh once per second.

Personal.Label: Timers slider
Personal.Description: Each user controls it under Playlists → User Volume Controls.

Formula.Label: Final volume
Formula.Description: Launch volume is multiplied by custom base volume and the user's timer volume.

Mute.Label: Mute
Mute.Description: Setting any participating slider to zero silences the signal.

FoundryMute.Label: Foundry global mute
FoundryMute.Description: Timer and break signals are not started while Foundry's global mute is enabled.

TimersManager.Title: Management
TimersManager.Intro: The upper form creates a timer; the lower table manages existing timers.

Name.Label: Name
Name.Description: Up to 120 characters; defaults to the next timer number.

Mode.Label: Mode
Mode.Description: Switches between a duration and an end time.

Time.Label: Time
Time.Description: Accepts SS, MM:SS, or HH:MM:SS as appropriate.

Visibility.Label: Visibility
Visibility.Description: Selects public for everyone or private for moderators.

Style.Label: Style
Style.Description: Selects a large prominent window or compact row.

Sound.Label: Sound
Sound.Description: A dropdown lists No sound, an available custom sound, then three standard signals.

CustomSound.Label: Custom sound
CustomSound.Description: Appears only after the custom timer sound is enabled and saved.

Volume.Label: Launch volume
Volume.Description: Sets this timer's volume and participates in the final volume formula.

Preview.Label: Preview
Preview.Description: Plays the selected signal with launch, custom base, and personal volumes.

Reset.Label: Reset
Reset.Description: Restores new-timer defaults and refreshes the suggested deadline.

Start.Label: Start
Start.Description: Validates, creates the timer and chat message, then opens the window.

Name.Label: Name
Name.Description: The button opens the timer window.

Remaining.Label: Remaining
Remaining.Description: Live countdown or zero for an expired timer.

Open.Label: Open
Open.Description: Use the eye button or double-click the row.

Repeat.Label: Repeat
Repeat.Description: The circular-arrow button immediately starts a new timer with the same name, duration, visibility, display style, signal, and volume. Repeating a break timer also pauses the world again.

Delete.Label: Delete
Delete.Description: Active timers require confirmation; expired timers are removed directly.

DeleteExpired.Label: Delete expired
DeleteExpired.Description: Deletes all expired timers after one confirmation.

ConfirmActive.Label: Active confirmation
ConfirmActive.Description: Prevents accidentally stopping a running timer.

TimersWindow.Title: Countdown window
TimersWindow.Intro: Closing or reopening a window does not alter the world timer.

Prominent.Label: Prominent
Prominent.Description: Shows a large name, remaining time, deadline, and controls.

Compact.Label: Compact
Compact.Description: Collapses the timer into a small row.

Toggle.Label: Toggle style
Toggle.Description: The style button or a double-click toggles an active timer's view.

Drag.Label: Move
Drag.Description: Drag the timer card around the screen.

Close.Label: Close
Close.Description: Closes only this client's window; the timer keeps running.

Cancel.Label: Cancel
Cancel.Description: Moderators can confirm stopping and deleting the timer.

ForceProminent.Label: Prominent mode
ForceProminent.Description: The window expands and moves to the front.

Sound.Label: Signal
Sound.Description: Plays the selected source with all volume levels multiplied.

Delete.Label: Delete
Delete.Description: A moderator can remove the expired timer from world state.

OncePerClient.Label: Once per client
OncePerClient.Description: Each client records an alert and does not replay it.

Watch.Label: Watch
Watch.Description: Reopens the timer from its chat card.

PublicCard.Label: Public card
PublicCard.Description: Visible to everyone with a public timer.

TimersBreak.Title: Break
TimersBreak.Intro: A quick break pauses the game and starts a public prominent timer.

Default.Label: Default
Default.Description: 15 minutes is selected when the window opens.

RoundedDeadline.Label: Rounding
RoundedDeadline.Description: The deadline rounds upward to the next full minute.

LiveDeadline.Label: Until line
LiveDeadline.Description: The proposed end time refreshes every five seconds.

Cancel.Label: Cancel
Cancel.Description: Closes without pausing or creating a timer.

Announce.Label: Announce break
Announce.Description: Pauses the game, creates the timer, and closes the dialog.

Pause.Label: Game pause
Pause.Description: The world is paused before the timer starts.

PublicTimer.Label: Public
PublicTimer.Description: The timer opens for all connected users.

Prominent.Label: Prominent
Prominent.Description: Break timers always start in the large style.

Signal.Label: Standard signal
Signal.Description: Signal 1 is used when no custom break signal is enabled.

CustomSignal.Label: Custom signal
CustomSignal.Description: When enabled and saved, its URL and base volume are used.

Chat.Label: Message
Chat.Description: Posts a deadline card with a Watch button.

NoAutoResume.Label: No automatic resume
NoAutoResume.Description: Timer expiration does not unpause the game.

RollbackPause.Label: Pause rollback
RollbackPause.Description: If timer creation fails, a newly applied pause is reverted.

StopwatchOverview.Title: Overview
StopwatchOverview.Intro: The stopwatch lets a moderator locally mark game moments and optionally publish the event log.

ModeratorOnly.Label: Permissions
ModeratorOnly.Description: The Stopwatch window is available to a Game Master or Assistant.

LocalState.Label: Local state
LocalState.Description: Clock progress and events exist only in the moderator's current client.

CloseKeeps.Label: Closing the window
CloseKeeps.Description: Keeps accumulated time and events for the current session.

ReloadResets.Label: Reload
ReloadResets.Description: Reloading the client clears the local clock and event list.

Minimize.Label: Window minimization
Minimize.Description: Double-clicking the title bar minimizes the window; double-clicking it again restores the full size.

Display.Label: Digital time
Display.Description: Shows accumulated duration with fractional seconds.

Pause.Label: Pause
Pause.Description: Stops incrementing while preserving accumulated time.

StopReset.Label: Stop and reset
StopReset.Description: Stops and clears the clock without deleting events.

Accumulation.Label: Resume
Accumulation.Description: A start after pause adds to the existing duration.

StopwatchEvents.Title: Events
StopwatchEvents.Intro: Four buttons add visually distinct marks at the current stopwatch time.

Circle.Label: Circle
Circle.Description: Records an event with the circle icon.

Square.Label: Square
Square.Description: Records an event with the square icon.

Plus.Label: Plus
Plus.Description: Records an event with the plus icon.

Minus.Label: Minus
Minus.Description: Records an event with the minus icon.

Click.Label: Click
Click.Description: Adds an event at the current accumulated time.

Keyboard.Label: Keyboard
Keyboard.Description: Enter or Space activates a focused event button.

Timestamp.Label: Timestamp
Timestamp.Description: Captures the stopwatch value at registration.

Paused.Label: While paused
Paused.Description: Events may be recorded after time has accumulated, even while paused.

NotStarted.Label: Before start
NotStarted.Description: At zero time, the module asks you to start the stopwatch first.

Scroll.Label: Scroll
Scroll.Description: The list automatically moves to the newest event.

Drag.Label: Drag
Drag.Description: Drag an event icon to the hotbar.

ChatMacro.Label: Macro command
ChatMacro.Description: The created chat macro records that event type.

MacroUse.Label: Availability
MacroUse.Description: Works while this client has started or accumulated stopwatch time.

Metadata.Label: Owner and creation time
Metadata.Description: The macro command begins with comments containing the owning player's name and ID and the exact creation time.

Cleanup.Label: Automatic cleanup
Cleanup.Description: Removing the last current-user hotbar assignment deletes that exact module macro from the Macros collection without touching ordinary or other users' macros.

StopwatchOutput.Title: Output and cleanup
StopwatchOutput.Intro: The event log and clock are controlled separately for flexible reuse.

Post.Label: Post events to chat
Post.Description: Publishes the current event list as a table.

EmptyPost.Label: Empty log
EmptyPost.Description: Shows a notification instead of posting an empty table.

Clear.Label: Clear events
Clear.Description: Removes every row from the local event log.

ClearKeepsClock.Label: Clear log
ClearKeepsClock.Description: Does not pause or reset the stopwatch.

NotSynchronized.Label: Multiple moderators
NotSynchronized.Description: Each moderator has a separate local stopwatch.

EventColumn.Label: Event column
EventColumn.Description: Shows the event icon and name.

AuditOverview.Title: Overview
AuditOverview.Intro: Audit helps moderators assess participation using player status and elapsed times for key actions.

ModeratorOnly.Label: Permissions
ModeratorOnly.Description: Focus Audit and Focus Audit Settings are available to a Game Master or Assistant.

WorldState.Label: World state
WorldState.Description: Statuses, enabled users, and metric timestamps are stored and synchronized.

AutoRefresh.Label: Refresh
AutoRefresh.Description: The open window recalculates durations and zones every five seconds.

Good.Label: Good
Good.Description: The metric has not reached the doubt threshold.

Doubt.Label: Doubt
Doubt.Description: The first threshold has been crossed.

Problem.Label: Problem
Problem.Description: The second threshold has been crossed.

Deadline.Label: Deadline
Deadline.Description: The third and most severe threshold has been crossed.

Muted.Label: Disabled
Muted.Description: The player is excluded from audit and their controls are muted.

Enabled.Label: Enabled player
Enabled.Description: Participates in evaluation and receives metric colors.

Disabled.Label: Disabled player
Disabled.Description: Remains visible but is not evaluated.

Sorting.Label: Sorting
Sorting.Description: Enabled players appear before disabled players.

AuditStatus.Title: Player status
AuditStatus.Intro: Every user can report their current state from the player list.

PlayerList.Label: Player list
PlayerList.Description: A status control is added to every user row.

Selector.Label: Dropdown
Selector.Description: Selects one of four clear statuses.

Indicator.Label: Color indicator
Indicator.Description: Shows the selected state beside the name.

Playing.Label: Playing
Playing.Description: The player is actively participating; green.

PlayerRequest.Label: Player request
PlayerRequest.Description: A change is sent to the primary moderator over the module socket.

PrimaryModerator.Label: Primary moderator
PrimaryModerator.Description: Validates and writes authoritative world state.

PrivateNotice.Label: Notification
PrivateNotice.Description: The player and moderators receive a private old-to-new status message.

LoginDefault.Label: World entry
LoginDefault.Description: An active unknown or newly connected user is set to Playing.

AuditWindow.Title: Focus Audit
AuditWindow.Intro: The table combines Foundry presence, self-reported status, and four elapsed-time metrics.

Enable.Label: Enable
Enable.Description: Includes the player in evaluation or excludes them.

SelfStatus.Label: Player status
SelfStatus.Description: Shows Playing, Listening, Away, or Unavailable.

LastRequest.Label: Last request
LastRequest.Description: Time since the player's latest module request.

ActiveRequest.Label: Active request
ActiveRequest.Description: Age of their oldest active request; resets when none remain.

LastChat.Label: Last chat
LastChat.Description: Time since a normal message, poll answer, or readiness result.

LastGranted.Label: Last granted
LastGranted.Description: Time since a request grant or manual grant mark.

Grant.Label: Grant
Grant.Description: Marks the current moment as the player's last granted time.

ResetPlayer.Label: Reset player
ResetPlayer.Description: After confirmation resets timestamps while preserving enabled and self status.

ResetAll.Label: Reset all
ResetAll.Description: After confirmation resets metric timestamps for every player.

Settings.Label: Focus Audit Settings
Settings.Description: Opens Focus Audit Settings with color-zone thresholds for each metric.

Tooltips.Label: Tooltips
Tooltips.Description: Show exact elapsed duration and the current zone.

RequestsIntegration.Label: Requests
RequestsIntegration.Description: Submission, granting, and queue cleanup update request metrics.

ChatIntegration.Label: Chat and polls
ChatIntegration.Description: Normal and meaningful response messages count; module technical cards do not.

AuditSettings.Title: Focus Audit Settings
AuditSettings.Intro: For each elapsed-time metric, the moderator defines entry points for three warning zones.

PerMetric.Label: Separate block
PerMetric.Description: Last request, active request, chat, and grant are configured independently.

Description.Label: Description
Description.Description: Explains which action updates the metric.

Doubt.Label: Doubt
Doubt.Description: First transition out of the good zone.

Save.Label: Save
Save.Description: Validates and writes thresholds to world settings.

LiveUpdate.Label: Apply
LiveUpdate.Description: An open audit window receives new zones without reloading.

Validation.Label: Error
Validation.Description: Negative values or invalid ordering are not saved.

Unknown.Label: Unknown
Unknown.Description: No current self-selected status is available for this player.

Playing.Label: Playing
Playing.Description: Fully immersed in the game context and available for requests.

Listening.Label: Listening
Listening.Description: Hearing and/or seeing the game, but not ready to act actively right now.

Away.Label: Away
Away.Description: Temporarily distracted or away from the computer; not following the game, but should return soon or can be called for urgent matters.

Unavailable.Label: Unavailable
Unavailable.Description: Away and not following the game; do not wait, continue without this player.

Status.ChatDetails: Player {player} changes status from {oldStatus} to {newStatus}. Meaning: {description}

Audit.Heading: Focus Audit
Audit.ResetAllConfirm: Reset audit data for all players?

Columns.FoundryStatusHint: Foundry player status: green if online, red if offline.

LastRequest.Title: Last request
LastRequest.Description: Time when the player last submitted a request through the module

ActiveRequest.Title: Active request
ActiveRequest.Description: Time elapsed since the first current active request that has not been granted or cancelled

LastChat.Title: Chat messages
LastChat.Description: Time when a chat message was last published on behalf of the player, regardless of cause or content

LastGranted.Title: Floor granted
LastGranted.Description: Time elapsed since the player was last granted the floor through module requests or manually from the audit window
